title: Premise drift never resets, and a stale drop's evidence is free text: stamp console re-verification, verify cited evidence on the host, and screen stale items before the planner spends a lane
summary: F40 architecture review M3 + M5 + follow-up (a)-(c). (1) FiledAt is fixed at filing, so an item the console re-verifies and re-queues shows the same premise_drift forever and can bounce between lanes (stale drop → console → re-queue → stale drop). (2) `stale: <evidence>` is free text: nothing checks a cited sha exists and is an ancestor of HEAD, or a cited file exists — a lazy triage can drop real work cheaply (with F30 that yields a SKIPPED lane plus a console item). (3) The wave planner picks items before any lane runs: a stale item still burns scout + triage before the drop.
fix: (1) `premise_verified_at` (+ the sha verified against), stamped when the console confirms a premise; drift measures from the later of it and created_at; a Signal Center code when the same id is stale-dropped twice, escalating instead of looping. (2) In F30's hand-off, verify cited evidence deterministically (a cited sha exists and is an ancestor of HEAD; a cited file:line's file exists at HEAD), record evidence_verified beside routed_reason, and flag a stale drop with no drift and no id-naming commit. (3) Planner-side cheap pre-filters: never dispatch an item with vanished declared paths or a commit naming its id without a premise re-check; and a batched wave-boundary premise audit over the top-K dispatchable items (stale → console, never consumed; mis-scoped → narrowed; confirmed → premise_verified_at).
acceptance: A console-confirmed premise resets the drift window (premise_verified_at), pinned in phases/triage premise_drift tests
A stale drop whose cited sha is not an ancestor of HEAD (or whose cited file is absent) is flagged evidence_verified=false in the routed item, pinned in cycleoutcome
The same id stale-dropped twice emits a coded escalation instead of a third lane
(from triage-zero-input-reads) Triage dropped its assigned task by asserting an unverified negative — zero reads of the assigned id's Scout occurrences
merge_notes: inbox review 2026-09-27: absorbed triage-zero-input-reads. premise-verification-anchor should absorb one extension: verify evidence on the host for the 'assigned id absent or invalid' drop too, not only for 'stale: <evidence>'. Such a drop must cite the scout-report lines it consulted, and the host checks those against the id's occurrences in scout-report.md (cycle-1571 H1: zero reads while the id appeared 7 times). The regression fixture needs re-authoring, because cycle 1571's artifacts are gone.
